decision: Retain every syntactically valid work email returned by FullEnrich and write the exact provider status to Twenty Person emailStatus.
rules: Do not discard a FullEnrich work email solely because the status is CATCH_ALL, INVALID, INVALID_DOMAIN or another provider value.
Write emails and emailStatus together and reconcile both.
Do not clear emailStatus when no provider work email is returned.
CATCH_ALL and invalid statuses remain reviewable and do not by themselves satisfy verified named-email contactability or authorise outreach.
